# JustWatch

> JustWatch is a comprehensive streaming guide that aggregates movies, TV shows, and sports content across all major streaming providers to help users discover where to watch.

JustWatch provides a centralized platform for browsing streaming catalogs from providers like Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, and others. The site enables content discovery across multiple streaming services while offering curated guides, news, and recommendations for entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Streaming catalog
- Movies and TV shows
- Content discovery
- Where to watch
- Streaming providers
- Watch online
- Streaming guide
- Netflix
- Disney+
- HBO Max
- Amazon Prime Video
- Hulu
- Content availability
- Streaming availability
- Sports streaming

## Core Streaming Discovery

- [JustWatch - The Streaming Guide](https://www.justwatch.com): JustWatch homepage: streaming guide aggregating all services.
- [JustWatch US - The Streaming Guide for Movies and TV Shows](https://www.justwatch.com/us): US streaming guide for discovering where to watch movies/TV.
- [JustWatch - New and recently added movies and TV shows](https://www.justwatch.com/us/new): Browse newly released and recently added content across streaming.

## Major Streaming Providers

- [Netflix - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/netflix): Complete Netflix catalog with JustWatch discovery tools.

- [HBO Max - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/hbo-max): HBO Max full catalog with JustWatch streaming discovery.
- [Amazon Prime Video - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/amazon-prime-video): Full Amazon Prime Video catalog browsable via JustWatch.
- [Hulu - full list of movies and TV shows online](https://www.justwatch.com/us/provider/hulu): Complete Hulu catalog with JustWatch streaming discovery.

## Specialized Content

- [JustWatch Sports](https://sports.justwatch.com/us): JustWatch Sports: stream sports leagues, tournaments, events.
- [The latest news & movie & TV show lists on JustWatch](https://guides.justwatch.com/us): Entertainment news, movie/TV lists, and curated recommendations.
